verdict.rationale: Lium is a hosted GPU rental marketplace, and self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS platform of this kind. The evidence covers only the hosted service: CLI, API, SDK, MCP docs server and pod rental. A provider quickstart page is mentioned, but supplying GPUs to the marketplace is an adjacent feature, not deploying the core product yourself. There is no documented way to run the Lium platform on your own infrastructure.
